title: add rag agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add a set of RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to help developers onboard quickly and demonstrate best practices for safe tool invocation and structured responses. This PR includes example projects (Python + TypeScript), new RAG templates, a new agents guide on the docs site, and small docs-site plumbing to surface the new content. Changes are intentionally small and example-focused so they can be reviewed and released independently.

What changed (high level): added two quickstarts (python + ts) under redwood-examples, new RAG templates and example prompts, docs site guide for agents and tool-calling, updated docs sidebar and mkdocs config, and minor lint/format fixes for examples.

Checklist:
- [x] Add Python quickstart with step-by-step instructions and runnable examples
- [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and compiled examples for tests
- [x] Add RAG templates and baseline evaluation prompts
- [x] Update docs site navigation and guide pages
- [x] CI passes for examples and docs build

Related Linear: ENG-4128 (agent quickstarts), ENG-4173 (docs guide), PM-221 (developer onboarding).

Notes: Examples use the public Redwood SDK quickstart patterns and include explicit guidance for using pinned model versions in Dedicated/Private deployments. The tool-calling examples demonstrate safe tool schemas and validation patterns to avoid arbitrary code execution. Please prioritize review of the docs text and code examples for clarity and security considerations.
